profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a customer-focused engineer with extensive experience both at small and huge scale. I've been the solo engineer building version 1.0 for a product trying to find market fit, and I've built resilient systems that serve massive scale at YouTube and Azure. I've worked across technology stacks from front end work in React, to mobile work on Android, to backend work in Java, Python, C#, and C++.

Beyond versatility I have deep experience with systems design, cloud architecture, and scalability. I have strong communication and problem-solving skills, and a knack for finding technical solutions to real problems faced by customers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Joined Mosey as employee #5 and built up through launch and growth to acquisition by Gusto. I built much of the compliance platform in our Python FastAPI backend, including an authoring framework for making quick accurate compliance configuration updates, and the compliance engine to tell users what compliance obligations they have when. At Gusto we're building Gusto Business Compliance to help businesses manage their compliance needs across the US.
positions.insights: Skills: TypeScript · Data Structures · Python (Programming Language) · Git

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: As a member of the Azure Active Directory Data Store team I maintained and enhanced a root tier Azure service serving identity data for Microsoft and Azure customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked on YouTube Product Infrastructure and Android Automotive teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Working with Java, Kotlin, and Postgres to build out a multi-tenant scalable server data API for food industry tracking and traceability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Through two acquisitions by Demandtec(March 2011) and subsequently IBM(February 2012), I delivered high-quality features and performance improvements to M-Factor's M4 marketing analytics, modeling, and prediction platform.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
Designed and developed a Java cell phone application to collect cell phone specifications.

Wrote C#/ASP.NET server side code to receive these specifications and store them in a SQL database.

Designed and developed an internal web application in C#/ASP.NET to view and modify information from this phone database.

positions.title: Development Intern
positions.description:
Wrote a Java GUI to parse and display information from the text output of another program.

Helped write a series of C++ drivers to control various lab equipment via a serial connection.

Performed on-location testing and data gathering in San Antonio and Atlanta.

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description:
Conducted in-field testing of equipment and generated bug reports.

Wrote perl and python scripts to automate the processing and analysis of test data.

positions.title: Educational Issues Intern
positions.description:
Helped collect data and organize reports on various educational issues for both internal and public circulation.

Helped organize an initiative to provide additional training to local middle school math teachers.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
Contributing to a number of small projects, including editing scientific papers and data analysis.

Helped process and analyze results generated by a coworker's computer simulations of capacitor systems.

company.name: Satellite Test of the Equivalence Principle

positions.title: Data Analysis and Lab Intern
positions.description:
In 2003 worked mainly in data processing and analysis of computer simulation and test results.

In 2004 mostly conducted small scale laboratory experiments measuring resistances of circuits and cryogenic temperatures.
